chapter_outcomes: Recall and use the equation: density (kilogram per cubic metre, kg/m³) = mass (kilogram, kg) ÷ volume (cubic metre, m³), ρ = m/V

Core Practical 14.3: Investigate the densities of solid and liquids - determine density by measuring mass and volume, including displacement method for irregular objects and direct measurement for liquids
Explain the differences in density between the different states of matter in terms of the arrangements of the atoms or molecules
